scope: Bounded read-only arithmetic and CLI recheck; temporary synthetic DB only

rejections.zero_growth_defined_but_scope_unsupporte: Zero growth is mathematically defined with nonzero ROC, but unsupported in this initial author-example scope
rejections.zero_roc_undefined: ROC_new=0 is an undefined denominator; no substitute is supplied
rejections.both_zero_denominator_precedence: ROC_new=0 is an undefined denominator; no substitute is supplied
rejections.missing_nopat_value: nopat_next must contain exactly ['basis', 'concept', 'data_kind', 'period', 'rationale', 'source_refs', 'timing', 'value']; unknown fields are rejected
rejections.pretax_concept: nopat_next.concept must be aftertax_operating_income_before_financing; no profit/rate conversion is performed
rejections.mixed_amount_unit: roc_new.basis must exactly match the request company/currency/unit/scope/accounting basis
rejections.mixed_company_basis: growth.basis must exactly match the request company/currency/unit/scope/accounting basis
rejections.mixed_period: NOPAT_next, growth and ROC_new must declare exactly the same next stable annual period
rejections.quarter_period: nopat_next.period.kind must declare full_fiscal_year; quarter/YTD periods are unsupported
rejections.missing_explicit_method: stable reinvestment request must contain exactly ['assessment', 'basis', 'growth', 'method', 'nopat_next', 'roc_new']; unknown fields are rejected

limitations: Source IDs, quotes, period labels and tax/ROC applicability are declarations, not verified evidence.
Displayed historical author numbers are used literally; author textual/rounding discrepancies are not corrected.
No DCF, forecast adoption, present issuer input, IR sending, scoring or investment judgment is performed.
Only the specified finite cases were checked; no full suite or broad input exploration was run.
